slides.title: A letter that sparkles
slides.text: A letter lands in the Netville post with big, exciting words. Pim reads it slowly. Exciting does not always mean true, says Pim.
slides.alt: Trick Inbox, Prize Letters: a letter from the Prize Team says you won a tablet. Its three clues are still hiding.

focus.cue: A letter with big, exciting words
Clues hide in its friendly text

slides.title: Clues one and two
slides.text: Clue one is a rush: reply in ten minutes or lose it! Clue two is a prize for a contest you never entered.
slides.alt: The tablet letter with all three clues found: you are our lucky winner, mailbox key, in the next ten minutes.

focus.cue: Clue one, the rush: in the next ten minutes
Clue two, a prize you never entered for

slides.title: Clues three and four
slides.text: Clue three: it comes from someone you do not know. Clue four asks for your key. Real companies and real games never ask for your passphrase.
slides.alt: A letter from the Post Office Team says your mailbox will close unless you send your mailbox key today.

focus.cue: Clue three: who really sent it?
Clue four: it asks for your mailbox key

slides.title: Count the clues
slides.text: Pim reads one more letter out loud. Count the clues hiding inside its friendly words before Pim decides.
steps: A prize you never entered for
A sender you do not know
slides.alt: A Game Shop letter offers a thousand free coins, but the offer ends in one hour. Both clues are found.

focus.cue: Free coins, and a rush: two clues

slides.title: What to do
slides.text: When you spot a trick, do not reply and do not tap anything. Show it to a trusted adult. A trick that fishes for secrets is called phishing.
slides.alt: Every clue found, the four moves wait under the letter: Deliver, Bin it, Show Pim, or Report and block.

focus.cue: Four moves: deliver, bin it, show Pim, report
Show Pim means show a trusted adult

words.means: a message that tries to fool you
a trick message that fishes for your secrets
a hint that something is not what it seems
something you win in a game or a draw

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Trick Inbox at Prize Letters and sort all 6 messages. Tap every clue you find, then choose: deliver it, bin it, show Pim, or report and block.
slides.alt: The tablet letter mid-hunt: one clue found, two still hiding, and the button to choose what to do.

focus.cue: Play Prize Letters: find every clue, then choose
